raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`--dataset-name image` loses a random fraction of its requests to HTTP 400 before they ever reach the model, and still reports the run as successful. On `amd/MiniMax-M3-MXFP4` the rejections read `"No data iterator found for token: ]<]video[>["` — a *video* placeholder, in an image benchmark that attaches no video.

Nothing reports the loss: the benchmark exits 0 and discards the error body. Throughput and latency are then computed over a smaller request set than asked for making those numbers unreliable for multimodal inputs

Prerequisite for trusting any `--dataset-name image` result, including the VL numbers
in the MiniMax-M3 series (#41662, #41663, #41664, #41672). #38035 is the
companion fix, correcting vision-token *accounting* on the same path; different files,
neither depends on the other.

## Modifications

`get_available_multimodal_text_tokens()` additionally excludes
`tokenizer.get_added_vocab().values()`, behind a `callable` guard for tokenizers that
do not implement it. Excluding the added vocabulary covers image, video and audio
placeholders for any model, rather than only the one image id callers can pass in.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable — synthetic benchmark prompt generation only, not kernels or model
forward code.

New unit test `test_gen_mm_prompt_excludes_added_vocab_tokens`. Rebased onto main
`98fce73d`: **46 passed** in `test/registered/bench_fn/test_benchmark_datasets_api.py`.
Negative control — the same test against main's unpatched `common.py` fails with
`AssertionError: {2053} is not false`, i.e. the placeholder id was drawn into the
pool, so the test distinguishes the two states rather than passing unconditionally.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable — no inference-path change. The pool is rebuilt once per `lru_cache`
miss exactly as before.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -87,6 +87,16 @@ def gen_prompt(tokenizer, token_num):
 def get_available_multimodal_text_tokens(tokenizer, image_pad_id):
     """Get valid token ids for synthetic multimodal text prompts."""
     excluded_token_ids = set(getattr(tokenizer, "all_special_ids", []) or [])
+    # Media placeholders are not always registered as special tokens. MiniMax-M3, for
+    # example, keeps `]<]video[>[` in the added vocabulary only, so it stays sampleable
+    # here and `tokenizer.decode` renders it verbatim into the prompt text. The server
+    # resolves that text to a video modality, finds no video attached to the request,
+    # and rejects it with HTTP 400 "No data iterator found for token". Excluding the
+    # added vocabulary covers image, video and audio placeholders for any model, rather
+    # than only the image id the callers are able to pass in.
+    get_added_vocab = getattr(tokenizer, "get_added_vocab", None)
+    if callable(get_added_vocab):
+        excluded_token_ids.update((get_added_vocab() or {}).values())
     if image_pad_id is not None:
         excluded_token_ids.add(image_pad_id)
     return [

@@ -743,6 +743,33 @@ def fake_choices(population, k):
         self.assertFalse(special_token_ids & sampled_pool)
         self.assertTrue(sampled_pool)
 
+    def test_gen_mm_prompt_excludes_added_vocab_tokens(self):
+        # Media placeholders are not always registered as special tokens: MiniMax-M3
+        # keeps `]<]video[>[` in the added vocabulary only. Sampling one makes the
+        # server look for a video the request never carries, so it answers HTTP 400.
+        tokenizer = create_lightweight_tokenizer()
+        placeholders = ["]<]image[>[", "]<]video[>["]
+        tokenizer.add_tokens(placeholders)
+        placeholder_ids = set(tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids(placeholders))
+        # Precondition: these are exactly the tokens `all_special_ids` does not cover.
+        self.assertFalse(placeholder_ids & set(tokenizer.all_special_ids))
+        image_pad_id = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids("]<]image[>[")
+        captured_population = {}
+
+        def fake_choices(population, k):
+            captured_population["tokens"] = population
+            return population[:k]
+
+        with patch(
+            "sglang.benchmark.datasets.common.random.choices",
+            side_effect=fake_choices,
+        ):
+            gen_mm_prompt(tokenizer, image_pad_id, token_num=8)
+
+        sampled_pool = set(captured_population["tokens"])
+        self.assertFalse(placeholder_ids & sampled_pool)
+        self.assertTrue(sampled_pool)
+
     def test_gen_mm_prompt_is_independent_of_vocab_order(self):
         class OrderedVocabTokenizer:
             all_special_ids = []
